name: Accountability Summary
query:
WITH latest_movement AS (
    SELECT
        ami.asset,
        am.name AS movement_name,
        am.transaction_date,
        am.custom_remarks,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ami.asset ORDER BY am.transaction_date DESC, am.name DESC) AS rn
    FROM `tabAsset Movement` am
    JOIN `tabAsset Movement Item` ami ON am.name = ami.parent
    WHERE am.workflow_state IN ('Checked', 'Received')
),
movement_count AS (
    SELECT
        ami.asset,
        COUNT(*) AS movement_count
    FROM `tabAsset Movement` am
    JOIN `tabAsset Movement Item` ami ON am.name = ami.parent
    WHERE am.workflow_state IN ('Checked', 'Received')
    GROUP BY ami.asset
)

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN a.custom_custodian_name IS NULL OR a.custom_custodian_name = '' THEN a.custom_section
    else a.custom_custodian_name END as "Employee / Section:data:140",
    CASE 
        WHEN mc.movement_count >= 3 THEN lm.movement_name
        ELSE a.name 
    END AS "Doc No.:data:100",
    CASE 
        WHEN mc.movement_count >= 2 THEN DATE_FORMAT(lm.transaction_date,'%%m/%%d/%%Y')
        ELSE DATE_FORMAT(a.available_for_use_date,'%%m/%%d/%%Y')
    END AS "Date",
    a.asset_name AS "Asset Name",
    a.gross_purchase_amount AS "Unit Cost",
    a.purchase_receipt AS "Ref WRR",
    a.custom_notes AS "Notes",
    CASE 
        WHEN mc.movement_count >= 2 THEN lm.custom_remarks
        ELSE '' 
    END AS "Remarks"

FROM `tabAsset` a
LEFT JOIN movement_count mc ON mc.asset = a.name
LEFT JOIN latest_movement lm ON lm.asset = a.name AND lm.rn = 1
WHERE a.disposal_date IS NULL 
  AND a.calculate_depreciation = 0 
  AND a.docstatus < 2
ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.custom_custodian_name IS NULL OR a.custom_custodian_name = '' THEN a.custom_section
    else a.custom_custodian_name END, a.custom_notes ASC

name: Annual Sales Report
report_script:
def execute(filters=None):
    data = frappe.db.sql("""SELECT YEAR(posting_date) as year, SUM(grand_total) as total_sales
                           FROM `tabSales Invoice`
                           WHERE docstatus = 1
                           GROUP BY YEAR(posting_date)
                           ORDER BY year""", as_dict=True)
    columns = [
        {"fieldname": "year", "label": "Year", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 100},
        {"fieldname": "total_sales", "label": "Total Sales", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 150}
    ]
    return columns, data

name: Delivered Items To Be Billed
query:
select
    `tabDelivery Note`.`name` as "Delivery Note:Link/Delivery Note:120",
	`tabDelivery Note`.`customer` as "Customer:Link/Customer:120",
	`tabDelivery Note`.`customer_name` as "Customer Name::150",
	`tabDelivery Note`.`posting_date` as "Date:Date",

	`tabDelivery Note Item`.`item_code` as "Item:Link/Item:120",
	(`tabDelivery Note Item`.`base_amount` - `tabDelivery Note Item`.`billed_amt`*ifnull(`tabDelivery Note`.conversion_rate, 1)) as "Pending Amount:Currency:110",

    and `tabDelivery Note Item`.amount > 0
    and `tabDelivery Note Item`.billed_amt < `tabDelivery Note Item`.amount
order by `tabDelivery Note`.`name` desc

name: Employee Attendance Schedule
report_script:
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]

columns = [
    {"fieldname": "sched_date", "label": "SchedDate", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 90},
    {"fieldname": "day_of_week", "label": "DayOfWeek", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 90},
    {"fieldname": "sched_time_start", "label": "SchedTimeStart", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 110},
    {"fieldname": "sched_time_end", "label": "SchedTimeEnd", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 110},
    {"fieldname": "time_in", "label": "Time In", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 90},
    {"fieldname": "time_out", "label": "Time Out", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 90},
    {"fieldname": "late_hours", "label": "Late (Hour)", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 90},
    {"fieldname": "valid_ot", "label": "Valid OT", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 80},
    {"fieldname": "authorization_no", "label": "AuthorizationNo", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120},
    {"fieldname": "rest_day", "label": "RestDay", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100},
    {"fieldname": "holiday_type", "label": "HolidayType", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120},
    {"fieldname": "leave_type", "label": "LeaveType", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120},
]

rows = []
employee = filters.get("employee")

if not employee:
    frappe.throw("Please select an Employee.")

if not frappe.db.exists("Employee", employee):
    found = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", {"employee_name": employee}, "name")
    if found:
        employee = found
    else:
        frappe.throw("Employee '{0}' not found.".format(employee))

from_date_str = str(frappe.utils.getdate(filters.get("from_date")))
to_date_str = str(frappe.utils.getdate(filters.get("to_date")))

att_list = frappe.get_all(
    "Attendance",
    filters={"employee": employee, "attendance_date": ["between", [from_date_str, to_date_str]]},
    fields=[
        "name",
        "attendance_date",
        "in_time",
        "out_time",
        "shift",
        "status",
        "leave_type",
        "actual_overtime_duration",
    ],
    order_by="attendance_date asc",
)
att_map = {}
attendance_names = []
for att_row in att_list:
    att_map[str(att_row.attendance_date)] = att_row
    attendance_names.append(att_row.name)

shifts = frappe.get_all("Shift Type", fields=["name", "start_time", "end_time"])
shift_map = {}
for shift_row in shifts:
    shift_map[shift_row.name] = shift_row

emp_doc = frappe.get_doc("Employee", employee)
holiday_list = emp_doc.holiday_list or frappe.db.get_value("Company", emp_doc.company, "default_holiday_list")
holiday_map = {}
if holiday_list:
    holidays = frappe.get_all(
        "Holiday",
        filters={"parent": holiday_list, "holiday_date": ["between", [from_date_str, to_date_str]]},
        fields=["holiday_date", "description"],
    )
    for holiday_row in holidays:
        holiday_map[str(holiday_row.holiday_date)] = holiday_row

leave_map = {}
leave_apps = frappe.get_all(
    "Leave Application",
    filters={
        "employee": employee,
        "status": "Approved",
        "from_date": ["<=", to_date_str],
        "to_date": [">=", from_date_str],
    },
    fields=["from_date", "to_date", "leave_type"],
)
for leave_row in leave_apps:
    n_days = frappe.utils.date_diff(str(leave_row.to_date), str(leave_row.from_date))
    for i in range(n_days + 1):
        leave_map[str(frappe.utils.add_days(str(leave_row.from_date), i))] = leave_row.leave_type

authorization_map = {}
slip_names_by_date = {}
if frappe.db.exists("DocType", "Overtime Slip") and frappe.db.exists("DocType", "Overtime Details"):
    if attendance_names:
        details = frappe.get_all(
            "Overtime Details",
            filters={"reference_document": ["in", attendance_names]},
            fields=["parent", "reference_document"],
            order_by="idx asc",
        )
        parents = []
        for detail in details:
            if detail.parent and detail.parent not in parents:
                parents.append(detail.parent)

        submitted_slips = {}
        if parents:
            slips = frappe.get_all(
                "Overtime Slip",
                filters={"name": ["in", parents], "docstatus": 1},
                fields=["name"],
            )
            for slip in slips:
                submitted_slips[slip.name] = slip.name

        for detail in details:
            if detail.parent in submitted_slips and detail.reference_document not in authorization_map:
                authorization_map[detail.reference_document] = detail.parent

    date_details = frappe.get_all(
        "Overtime Details",
        filters={"date": ["between", [from_date_str, to_date_str]]},
        fields=["parent", "date"],
        order_by="idx asc",
    )
    parents = []
    for detail in date_details:
        if detail.parent and detail.parent not in parents:
            parents.append(detail.parent)

    submitted_slips = {}
    if parents:
        slips = frappe.get_all(
            "Overtime Slip",
            filters={"name": ["in", parents], "employee": employee, "docstatus": 1},
            fields=["name"],
        )
        for slip in slips:
            submitted_slips[slip.name] = slip.name

    for detail in date_details:
        detail_date = str(detail.date)
        if detail.parent in submitted_slips and detail_date not in slip_names_by_date:
            slip_names_by_date[detail_date] = detail.parent

total_days = frappe.utils.date_diff(to_date_str, from_date_str)
for day_idx in range(total_days + 1):
    ds = str(frappe.utils.add_days(from_date_str, day_idx))
    current = frappe.utils.getdate(ds)
    dow = current.weekday()
    day_name = DAYS[dow]
    is_weekend = dow >= 5
    att = att_map.get(ds)
    holiday = holiday_map.get(ds)
    leave_type = leave_map.get(ds) or (att.leave_type if att else "")
    shift = (att.shift if att else None) or (None if (is_weekend or holiday) else ("Monday Shift - QC" if dow == 0 else "Tue-Fri Shift - QC"))
    si = shift_map.get(shift) if shift else None

    sched_s = ""
    if si and si.start_time and not is_weekend and not holiday:
        total = si.start_time.seconds
        h = total // 3600
        m = (total % 3600) // 60
        suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
        h12 = h % 12 if h % 12 != 0 else 12
        sched_s = "%d:%02d %s" % (h12, m, suffix)

    sched_e = ""
    if si and si.end_time and not is_weekend and not holiday:
        total = si.end_time.seconds
        h = total // 3600
        m = (total % 3600) // 60
        suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
        h12 = h % 12 if h % 12 != 0 else 12
        sched_e = "%d:%02d %s" % (h12, m, suffix)

    ti = ""
    if att and att.in_time:
        h = att.in_time.hour
        m = att.in_time.minute
        suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
        h12 = h % 12 if h % 12 != 0 else 12
        ti = "%d:%02d %s" % (h12, m, suffix)

    to_ = ""
    if att and att.out_time:
        h = att.out_time.hour
        m = att.out_time.minute
        suffix = "AM" if h < 12 else "PM"
        h12 = h % 12 if h % 12 != 0 else 12
        to_ = "%d:%02d %s" % (h12, m, suffix)

    late = 0.0
    if att and att.in_time and si and si.start_time and not is_weekend and not holiday:
        diff = (att.in_time.hour * 3600 + att.in_time.minute * 60) - si.start_time.seconds
        if diff > 0:
            late = round(diff / 3600, 2)

    ot = 0.0
    if att and att.actual_overtime_duration:
        ot = round(float(att.actual_overtime_duration), 2)
    elif att and att.out_time and si and si.end_time and not is_weekend and not holiday:
        diff = (att.out_time.hour * 3600 + att.out_time.minute * 60) - si.end_time.seconds
        if diff > 0:
            ot = round(diff / 3600, 2)

    authorization_no = ""
    if att:
        authorization_no = authorization_map.get(att.name) or slip_names_by_date.get(ds) or ""

    rest = ds if (is_weekend or holiday) else ""
    htype = (holiday.description if holiday else "Weekly Off") if (is_weekend or holiday) else ""
    rows.append({
        "sched_date": ds,
        "day_of_week": day_name,
        "sched_time_start": sched_s,
        "sched_time_end": sched_e,
        "time_in": ti,
        "time_out": to_,
        "late_hours": late,
        "valid_ot": ot,
        "authorization_no": authorization_no,
        "rest_day": rest,
        "holiday_type": htype,
        "leave_type": leave_type or "",
    })

data = columns, rows

name: Oil Change Due
query:
SELECT
    v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:150",
    v.last_odometer AS "Current Odometer",
    vlo.odometer AS "Last Oil Change Odometer",
    vlo.last_service_date AS "Last Oil Change Date"
FROM
    `tabVehicle` v
LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT 
            l.license_plate,
            CAST(MAX(l.odometer) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS odometer,
            MAX(s.custom_service_date) AS last_service_date
        FROM `tabVehicle Log` l
        INNER JOIN `tabVehicle Service` s 
            ON s.parent = l.name
           AND s.service_item LIKE '%%ENGINE CHANGE OIL%%'
        GROUP BY l.license_plate
    ) vlo ON v.name = vlo.license_plate
    where vlo.last_service_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    v.name;

SELECT so.name AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:130", so.customer_name AS "Customer Name::180", so.customer AS "Customer Code:Link/Customer:120", soi.delivery_date AS "Date:Date:100", so.status as "Status::130", soi.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:180", soi.item_name AS "Item Name::0", soi.qty AS "Ordered Qty:Float:100", soi.delivered_qty AS "Delivered Qty:Float:120", -- Draft DR Qty IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(dni.qty) FROM `tabDelivery Note Item` dni JOIN `tabDelivery Note` dn ON dn.name = dni.parent WHERE dni.so_detail = soi.name AND dn.docstatus = 0 ), 0) AS "Draft DR Qty:Float:120", -- Related Delivery Note numbers (submitted only) IFNULL(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dn.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM `tabDelivery Note Item` dni JOIN `tabDelivery Note` dn ON dn.name = dni.parent WHERE dni.so_detail = soi.name AND dn.docstatus = 1 ), '-') AS "Delivery Notes(Completed):Link/Delivery Note:200", -- Related Delivery Note numbers (submitted only) IFNULL(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dn.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM `tabDelivery Note Item` dni JOIN `tabDelivery Note` dn ON dn.name = dni.parent WHERE dni.so_detail = soi.name AND dn.docstatus = 0 ), '-') AS "Delivery Notes(Draft):Link/Delivery Note:200", -- Progress Bar (delivered only) CONCAT( '
', '
', ROUND(IFNULL(soi.delivered_qty / NULLIF(soi.qty, 0), 0) * 100, 1), '%%
' ) AS "Progress (Delivered Only):HTML:180", -- Progress Bar (ALL) CONCAT( '
', '
', ROUND(IFNULL((soi.delivered_qty + (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(dni.qty), 0) FROM `tabDelivery Note Item` dni JOIN `tabDelivery Note` dn ON dn.name = dni.parent WHERE dni.so_detail = soi.name AND dn.docstatus = 0) ) / NULLIF(soi.qty, 0), 0) * 100, 1), '%%
' ) AS "Progress (ALL):HTML:180" FROM `tabSales Order` so JOIN `tabSales Order Item` soi ON soi.parent = so.name WHERE so.docstatus = 1 ORDER BY so.transaction_date DESC, so.name DESC

name: Sales Order Delivery Overview
query:
SELECT
    so.name AS "Sales Order",
    so.customer_name AS "Customer Name",
    so.customer AS "Customer Code",
    soi.item_code AS "Item Code",
    soi.item_name AS "Item Name",
    soi.qty AS "Ordered Qty",
    soi.delivered_qty AS "Delivered Qty",
    soi.qty - soi.delivered_qty as "SO Balance",
    IFNULL((
        SELECT SUM(dni.qty)
        FROM `tabDelivery Note Item` dni
        JOIN `tabDelivery Note` dn ON dn.name = dni.parent
        WHERE dni.so_detail = soi.name
          AND dn.docstatus = 0
    ), 0) AS "Draft DR Qty",
    soi.delivery_date AS "SO Delivery Date",
    so.status AS "SO Status" 
    
    
    
FROM `tabSales Order` so
JOIN `tabSales Order Item` soi ON soi.parent = so.name
WHERE so.docstatus = 1 AND soi.qty  <> soi.delivered_qty
AND so.status  = 'To Deliver and Bill' 
ORDER BY so.transaction_date DESC

name: Sales Partners Commission
query:
SELECT
   sales_partner as "Sales Partner:Link / Sales Partner:220",
   sum(base_net_total) as "Invoiced Amount (Excl. Tax):Currency:220",
   sum(amount_eligible_for_commission) as "Amount Eligible for Commission:Currency:220",
   sum(total_commission) as "Total Commission:Currency:170",
   sum(total_commission)*100 / sum(amount_eligible_for_commission) as "Average Commission Rate:Percent:220"
FROM
   (
      SELECT
         sales_partner,
         base_net_total,
         total_commission,
         amount_eligible_for_commission
      FROM
         `tabSales Invoice` 
      WHERE
         docstatus = 1
         AND IFNULL(base_net_total, 0) > 0
         AND IFNULL(total_commission, 0) > 0

      UNION ALL

      SELECT
         sales_partner,
         base_net_total,
         total_commission,
         amount_eligible_for_commission
      FROM
         `tabPOS Invoice`
      WHERE
         docstatus = 1
         AND IFNULL(base_net_total, 0) > 0
         AND IFNULL(total_commission, 0) > 0
   ) AS sub
GROUP BY
   sales_partner
ORDER BY
   "Total Commission:Currency:120"

name: Sales Vs Forecast
query:
SELECT * FROM (

    -- 1️⃣ Targets (with or without sales)
    SELECT
        sp.parent_sales_person AS "Parent Sales Person:Link/Sales Person:180",
        td.parent AS "Sales Person:Link/Sales Person:180",
        td.item_group AS "Item Group:Link/Item Group:150",
        '' AS "Item:Link/Item:120",
        '' AS "Item Name::180",
        td.target_amount AS "Target:Currency:120",
        COALESCE(SUM(sii.base_net_amount), 0) AS "Achieved:Currency:120",
        (COALESCE(SUM(sii.base_net_amount), 0) - td.target_amount) AS "Variance:Currency:120"
    FROM `tabTarget Detail` td
    JOIN `tabSales Person` sp ON sp.name = td.parent
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Team` st ON st.sales_person = td.parent
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = st.parent
        AND si.docstatus = 1
        AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
        AND sii.item_group = td.item_group
    WHERE td.parenttype = 'Sales Person'
      AND td.fiscal_year = %(fiscal_year)s
    GROUP BY sp.parent_sales_person, td.parent, td.item_group, td.target_amount

    UNION ALL

    -- 2️⃣ Sales without targets (so they don’t get lost)
    SELECT
        sp.parent_sales_person,
        st.sales_person,
        sii.item_group,
        '' AS item_code,
        '' AS item_name,
        0,
        SUM(sii.base_net_amount),
        SUM(sii.base_net_amount) -- variance = same as achieved since no target
    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
    JOIN `tabSales Team` st ON st.parent = si.name
    JOIN `tabSales Person` sp ON sp.name = st.sales_person
    JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
    WHERE si.docstatus = 1
      AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM `tabTarget Detail` td
          WHERE td.parent = st.sales_person
            AND td.item_group = sii.item_group
            AND td.fiscal_year = %(fiscal_year)s
            AND td.parenttype = 'Sales Person'
      )
    GROUP BY sp.parent_sales_person, st.sales_person, sii.item_group

    UNION ALL

    -- 3️⃣ Item-level breakdown (target = 0, variance = 0)
    SELECT
        sp.parent_sales_person,
        st.sales_person,
        sii.item_group,
        sii.item_code,
        sii.item_name,
        0,
        SUM(sii.base_net_amount),
        0
    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
    JOIN `tabSales Team` st ON st.parent = si.name
    JOIN `tabSales Person` sp ON sp.name = st.sales_person
    JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
    WHERE si.docstatus = 1
      AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    GROUP BY sp.parent_sales_person, st.sales_person, sii.item_group, sii.item_code, sii.item_name
) x
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4;

name: Work Orders in Progress
query:
SELECT
  `tabWork Order`.name as "Work Order:Link/Work Order:200",
  `tabWork Order`.creation as "Date:Date:120",
  `tabWork Order`.production_item as "Item:Link/Item:150",
  `tabWork Order`.qty as "To Produce:Int:100",
  `tabWork Order`.produced_qty as "Produced:Int:100",
  `tabWork Order`.company as "Company:Link/Company:"
FROM
  `tabWork Order`
WHERE
  `tabWork Order`.docstatus=1
  AND `tabWork Order`.status != 'Stopped'
  AND ifnull(`tabWork Order`.produced_qty,0) < `tabWork Order`.qty
  AND EXISTS (SELECT name from `tabStock Entry` where work_order =`tabWork Order`.name)
